subject: Post-call recap & procurement checklist — cloud marketplace options
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Lena Porter <lena.porter@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Jun 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & procurement checklist — cloud marketplace options

Hi Lena —

Thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap from our side and a short procurement checklist so we can map the right commercial path (AWS Marketplace vs PO/card):

Call highlights
- Use case: clinical notes summarization + embeddings for search across internal docs
- Traffic profile: low QPS today, expected ramp to ~30 QPS in 6–9 months
- Primary cloud: AWS (us-west-2) but evaluating multi-cloud readiness

Procurement / commercial questions (can you confirm?):
1) Preferred purchase method: PO (Net30) or corporate card?
2) Is there interest in buying through AWS Marketplace (metered/subscription) or do you need a direct vendor PO?
3) Who owns vendor onboarding (legal/procurement)? Please share contact & intake form if available.
4) Any required security artifacts (SOC 2, penetration test report, vendor questionnaire)?
5) Expected timeline for contract signing and first invoice?

Attached: redwood-procurement-playbook.pdf (quick reference: marketplace vs direct PO flow, required docs we typically see).

Proposed next steps
- If you're open to Marketplace, we can scope listing time and required pricing mapping (I can loop in our Marketplace lead).
- If PO path is required, we'll prepare a standard SOW + W9 and your PO template.
- Proposed follow-up: short sync with procurement and our commercial ops (15–20 min) — does Jul 2 or Jul 3 work?

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachment: redwood-procurement-playbook.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Lena Porter <lena.porter@acmehealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & procurement checklist — cloud marketplace options

Hi Sean —

Appreciate the detailed recap — super helpful. Quick answers inline:

1) Preferred purchase method: Procurement prefers PO (Net30) for vendors we expect to spend >$5k/month; occasional smaller pilots on card.
2) Marketplace interest: We prefer AWS Marketplace for ease of billing and cost allocation, but only if the listing and pricing alignment can be done within ~3–4 weeks. If Marketplace will take longer, we'll move forward by PO.
3) Vendor onboarding: Procurement owns this — I've cc'd them. They typically require our vendor intake form filled out (attached).
4) Security artifacts: Yes — SOC 2 Type II or summary + a completed security questionnaire.
5) Timeline: If paperwork is straightforward, we can complete onboarding in 2–4 weeks and issue the first PO.

I've attached the vendor intake spreadsheet (vendor-intake-request.xlsx) — please work with procurement on the fields they need filled.

Also: procurement@acmehealth.com is the best routing for legal/vendor forms.

Thanks — Lena
Lena Porter
Senior PM, Clinical Informatics | Acme Health
lena.porter@acmehealth.com

Attachment: vendor-intake-request.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 13:10:00 -0700
Subject: Intro & vendor intake — Redwood Inference (Acme Health) — AWS Marketplace vs PO path

Hi Procurement team —

Thanks for looping in. I'm Sean Gallagher from Redwood Inference (cc'd: Marissa Cole, Commercial Ops; Karthik Iyer, Solutions). We're excited to move forward with Acme Health on the clinical notes pilot.

Attached is our procurement playbook and the info Lena referenced. A couple asks so we can prepare the right artifacts quickly:
- Could you confirm the specific fields in the vendor intake you need filled vs. what can be provided after initial approval?
- Do you have a preferred PO template we should reference for billing and remit details?
- For Marketplace: if Acme prefers AWS Marketplace, can you confirm the internal approval path and any catalog/pricing constraints (e.g., single-subscription vs metered billing)?
- Required tax/vendor docs (W9) and security artifacts (SOC 2) — we can provide immediately.

Deal info
- Deal ID: RWI-ACME-2025-01
- Proposed pilot start: mid-July

I'll start assembling the W9 and SOC 2 summary; Karthik will scope the Marketplace listing effort and timeline. Marissa will coordinate commercial terms and the mutual action plan.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-procurement-playbook.pdf, vendor-intake-request.xlsx
From: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Porter <lena.porter@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jul 2025 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro & vendor intake — Redwood Inference (Acme Health) — AWS Marketplace vs PO path

Sean —

Thanks for the intro. We reviewed the intake and filled the required fields — attached: acme_vendor_form_filled.xlsx. A few notes:
- Marketplace: We prefer AWS Marketplace but will only move to marketplace billing if listing can be completed within 4 weeks and pricing can be mapped to our cost center structure. Otherwise, we'll issue a standard PO (Net30).
- Required docs: W9 (US entities), SOC 2 Type II report or executive summary, and proof of insurance.
- PO process: Once vendor is approved, we issue a PO referencing your invoice terms; payment on Net30 from the PO date.
- Portal: Please upload vendor docs to our procurement portal: https://procure.acmehealth.com/vendor/12345 (credentials will be sent by separate email).

Please upload the W9 and SOC 2 summary and we can start the vendor approval.

Regards,
Acme Health Procurement Team
procurement@acmehealth.com

Attachment: acme_vendor_form_filled.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Porter <lena.porter@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jul 2025 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & timeline — W9/SOC2 + Marketplace scoping

Thanks team — quick plan to keep momentum: 

1) Artifacts (by EOD Jul 3): I will upload W9.pdf and a short SOC2-summary.pdf to Acme's portal link.
2) Marketplace scoping (Marissa): Marissa to confirm estimated listing time (I expect 2–3 weeks contingent on catalogue approvals). If listing < 4 weeks, we will pursue AWS Marketplace for ease of billing; otherwise we'll accept PO Net30.
3) Demo & MAP: Sean to schedule a 30-min pilot demo with Lena + engineering (proposed Jul 8, 10:00–10:30 PT). I'll prepare a short mutual action plan and send via DocuSign (link will be generated).
4) Commercials: Marissa to prepare a short one-page pricing summary for both Marketplace subscription mapping and PO invoice pricing so procurement can compare apples-to-apples.

Links / trackers:
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/RWI-ACME-2025-01
- Draft MAP (DocuSign to follow): https://docusign.com/ENVELOPEID/ABC123

I'll upload the W9 and SOC2-summary to the portal and follow up once complete. Sean — please confirm the demo slot or suggest alternatives.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
